basic_info.description: House-like top 2-floor Unit (Third and Fourth floors)! Soaring 10-foot ceilings on both levels and large windows set the stage for this modern, 2-story townhouse style condo in the heart of the Sunset. Stunning brand new engineered hardwood floors throughout! Enjoy sweeping ocean views from the living room and dining room in this well-maintained 2-bed 2-bath home, a generously sized additional room offers flexibility as a home office, game room, or guest space. The home has a bright and airy ambiance and a functional layout, offering both comfort and convenience. It's also the only unit in the complex equipped with a Level 2 EV charger. Just steps from popular shops and restaurants along Taraval Street, as well as the library and nearby parks. Walk to tech shuttle stops, quick access to West Portal, Stonestown, Whole Foods, Target, and major commute routes, everyday living is effortless! Don't miss this rare opportunity to own this modern and elegant home!
